clock_bounds.note: neither bound may be what stops a call -- both arms are meant to terminate on their iteration bound. These two need not be equal, but if one binds and the other does not, the rate difference is an instrument artifact and not a finding about the port. no-timeouts is the check for that on the port arm; the cpp arm reports a clock stop as its own error code.
